title: Superliminal
description: A Minecraft datapack that recreates the Superliminal mechanics
body:
You can enjoy amazing optical illusions just like in Superliminal!

## Features
The near is large and the far is small? Its size seems the same!

You can even step on the block!

## Dependencies
* (Required) [Bookshelf View](https://modrinth.com/project/rkt9Av0Z)

## Demo
[Watch Video on Bilibili](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1SfSTBfE9E/?share_source=copy_web&vd_source=c9cd315de687845cb7a2d835d3200b37)

## Known Issues
* Due to vanilla limitation, the max size of the block collision is about 3 blocks wide.
